Discover Loire Valley Châteaux & Cave Homes | €136/night | History & Unique Stays
top of page
​ Discover the Ch teaux and Cave Homes of the Loire Valley
The Loire Valley is a treasure trove of history, architecture, and natural beauty, making it a must-visit destination in France. Known as the "Garden of France," this UNESCO World Heritage Site is famous for its stunning ch teaux and unique cave dwellings. Visitors to the Loire Valley can explore the grandeur of medieval and Renaissance castles by day and relax in the charm of a modern cave home by night. Here's everything you need to know about experiencing the best of both worlds in the Loire Valley.
The Majestic Ch teaux of the Loire Valley
​The Loire Valley is home to some of the most iconic ch teaux in France, each offering a glimpse into the region's royal past. These architectural marvels, surrounded by lush landscapes and winding rivers, attract travelers from around the globe.
​
Ch teau de Chambord: A masterpiece of French Renaissance architecture, this ch teau is known for its grand staircase, designed by Leonardo da Vinci, and its expansive grounds. A visit to Chambord is a journey through the history of French kings.
Ch teau de Chenonceau : Often called the "Ladies' Ch teau," Chenonceau is famous for its stunning arches that span the River Cher. Its beautifully maintained gardens and rich history make it a favorite among visitors.
Ch teau Royal d'Amboise: Located in the heart of Amboise, this castle offers panoramic views of the Loire River. It's also the final resting place of Leonardo da Vinci, who spent the last years of his life here.
Exploring these ch teaux allows visitors to step back in time and experience the splendor of the French Renaissance, making them an essential part of any Loire Valley itinerary.
////////////////////////////////////////////////////
The Hidden Gem: Cave Homes in the Loire Valley
​While the ch teaux are well-known, the Loire Valley is also home to another type of unique dwelling cave homes. These troglodyte dwellings, carved into the limestone cliffs, date back centuries and have been used as homes, wine cellars, and even chapels. Today, Amboise Troglodyte has transformed caves into cozy and modern accommodations, offering a one-of-a-kind lodging experience.
Staying in a cave home is an opportunity to connect with the region's history in a truly immersive way. These lodgings provide a blend of rustic charm and contemporary comfort, making them perfect for travelers looking for something out of the ordinary.
Why Experience Both?
Combining a visit to the ch teaux with a stay in a cave home offers a complete Loire Valley experience. Spend your days exploring grand castles, learning about the region's royal history, and then retreat to the peace and quiet of your cave accommodation. The cool, naturally insulated environment of the caves is perfect for relaxation after a day of sightseeing.
Plan Your Visit
Ready to explore the best of the Loire Valley? Book a stay at Amboise Troglodyte , where you can experience the charm of our converted caves while being just a short drive away from the most famous ch teaux. Discover the perfect balance between history and comfort and make your Loire Valley adventure unforgettable.

Cave Accommodations in the Loire Valley
​
​​What Is a Troglodyte Cave Accommodation?
Troglodyte homes are traditional dwellings carved directly into the soft tufa stone that defines the Loire Valley. Historically used as homes, wine cellars, and workshops, these caves naturally regulate temperature year‑round, remaining cool in summer and warm in winter.
Today, carefully restored Amboise Troglodyte caves offer a rare blend of authentic historical architecture, a natural insulation and comfort, and a peaceful and atmospheric environment. Amboise Troglodyte has preserved the soul of the cave while adding modern amenities to ensure a comfortable stay.
​
Stay in an Authentic Troglodyte Cave near Amboise
Looking for a unique cave accommodation in the Loire Valley? Welcome to Amboise Troglodyte , an authentic troglodyte dwelling carved into the limestone cliff. Combining centuries‑old history with modern comfort, our cave accommodations offer a truly memorable stay in the heart of the Loire Valley.
Whether you are planning a romantic getaway, a cultural trip, or a slow‑travel escape surrounded by nature and heritage, staying in a troglodyte cave is one of the most distinctive ways to experience this UNESCO-listed region. ​ ​ ​ ​ ​
​ ​
​ ​
A Unique and Memorable Experience
Unlike traditional hotels or g tes, cave accommodations offer a stay you simply cannot replicate elsewhere. Sleeping in a carved stone cave connects you directly to the region's history and landscape. ​​
​
​
Ideal Location
Amboise Troglodyte accommodations are ideally located. Amboise is one of the Loire Valley's most charming towns, famous for:
Ch teau Royal d'Amboise
Clos Luc , Leonardo da Vinci's final residence
Vineyards and wine cellars carved into the cliffs
​ ​
​ ​
Naturally Quiet and Relaxing
The thick stone walls create a calm and serene atmosphere, perfect for rest, disconnection, and slow travel.
​ ​
​ ​
Comfort Meets History
Our cave accommodations include:
Comfortable bedrooms carved into the rock
Private bathrooms with modern facilities
Careful lighting that enhances the natural stone
Every detail has been designed to respect the cave's character while ensuring a high level of comfort. ​
​
​
Perfect for Couples and Curious Travelers
Amboise Troglodyte is ideal for romantic weekends in the Loire Valley, for history and architecture enthusiasts and for travelers seeking unique and authentic stays.
​ ​
​
Things to Do Around Your Cave Accommodation
Staying at Amboise Troglodyte caves places you at the center of some of the Loire Valley's best experiences:
Visit Loire Valley ch teaux: Amboise, Chenonceau, Chaumont‑sur‑Loire,
Wine tasting in local troglodyte cellars
Cycling along the Loire V lo route
Explore local markets and restaurants in Amboise
Discover lesser‑known villages and hidden caves
We are happy to share personalized recommendations to help you make the most of your stay.
​
Is a Cave Accommodation Comfortable?
Yes. Many guests are pleasantly surprised by the comfort of our Amboise Troglodyte accommodations. Thanks to natural stone insulation, the temperature remains stable, and humidity is carefully managed. Modern bedding, heating, and ventilation ensure a restful night's sleep in a truly unique setting.
​
